purpose: Read-only implementation-family planning for the six Clanks with the M1 STD-OPS-COM-003 qualification provenance/reset evidence gap. No target is remediated or admitted by this artifact.
shared_contract: execution authority establishes provenance -> material identity is computed -> required epoch reset occurs before gated use -> evidence is persisted against execution/epoch -> downstream gates consume but never invent provenance
shared_invariants: Every real execution authority supplies provenance structurally; scheduled, manual, deploy-verification, recovery, retry, and unknown paths remain distinguishable wherever they exist.
Material identity is a trustworthy release/config/schema identity, not a product or content identity.
A material change appends an auditable reset containing explicit prior material identity, new identity, reason, authority, and time before first changed-run gate evaluation.
Qualification evidence is linked to execution and epoch; reset and terminal execution facts are independently persisted when needed.
Downstream delivery consumes persisted provenance and never fabricates NATURAL or equivalent provenance; absent/divergent provenance is UNKNOWN and fail-closed where required.
This planning contract does not make an existing continuity, host-migration, campaign, or editorial epoch a qualification epoch.

target_observations.authority_boundary: External OS scheduler, manual CLI, and dashboard invocation converge on a stateless one-shot runner; no trigger is passed into the runner.
target_observations.evidence_boundary: SQLite crawler_runs plus snapshots, events, and source health.
target_observations.material_identity: Product/configuration keys and content hashes identify observations, not release/config material identity.
target_observations.reset_boundary: No qualification epoch or reset lineage; first decision is whether an applicable qualification lifecycle exists.
target_observations.gate_boundary: Due/health/completed-run checks; production is explicitly unverified/frozen and no epoch-aware promotion gate exists.
target_observations.persistence_model: Embedded SQLite schema version 7 with local migrations.
target_observations.migration_need: Additive qualification records only after applicability is confirmed; preserve crawler history and do not overload product hashes.
target_observations.risk: Highest ambiguity: adding a lifecycle could be a governance change rather than a remediation.

target_observations.authority_boundary: OperationalScheduler persists MANUAL_CLI, MANUAL_GUI, SCHEDULER, STARTUP_CATCHUP, RETRY, and TEST on OperationalJobRun with owner and lease identity.
target_observations.evidence_boundary: Operational jobs/leases, provider runs, signal items/candidates, promotion events, evidence, and editorial stories.
target_observations.material_identity: Candidate fingerprints/content hashes identify signal evidence, not deployed code/config or qualification identity.
target_observations.reset_boundary: Job trigger provenance exists, but no qualification epoch, material-change detector, or explicit reset lineage.
target_observations.gate_boundary: Candidate eligibility, thresholds, budgets, and manual/automatic promotion; editorial promotion is not soak qualification.
target_observations.persistence_model: SQLAlchemy/Alembic migrations, latest observed phase-9 operational automation migration.
target_observations.migration_need: Add a dedicated qualification projection linked to job execution; do not retrofit free-form promoted_by or candidate fingerprints.
target_observations.risk: Strongest scheduler evidence, but high semantic risk of confusing editorial promotion with qualification.

target_observations.authority_boundary: Foreground CLI/dashboard and portable soak invoke the same collector path; any future scheduler is external. RunLock serializes but does not establish trigger provenance.
target_observations.evidence_boundary: Aggregate runs, per-source health, fetch attempts, errors, articles, and QC/archive history.
target_observations.material_identity: Canonical URLs/content hashes and source status identify content, not release/config identity.
target_observations.reset_boundary: No qualification epoch; source history and production/experimental policy are narrative.
target_observations.gate_boundary: Source status plus health-history/promotion-policy review; no persisted fail-closed qualification gate.
target_observations.migration_need: Additive per-invocation/per-source provenance and qualification tables; preserve aggregate history and migration versions.
target_observations.risk: Aggregate invocation versus per-source evidence can lose authority linkage; the existing policy has no single gate boundary.

target_observations.authority_boundary: Manual dashboard and scheduled/CLI production runs converge on _run; production and experimental use separate stores/locks. No trigger provenance is passed.
target_observations.evidence_boundary: SQLite collector_runs, observations, classification log, events, and append-only continuity JSONL.
target_observations.material_identity: Product keys/content hashes/classifications identify data; production allowlist is configuration, not recorded material identity.
target_observations.reset_boundary: Continuity JSONL has data-loss epoch fpc-epoch-2, which must remain separate from qualification epoch/reset.
target_observations.gate_boundary: Scope allowlist and healthy/baseline run status; no explicit epoch-aware qualification gate.
target_observations.persistence_model: SQLite schema version 4 plus hash-tamper-evident JSONL continuity registry.
target_observations.migration_need: Add separate qualification/epoch/reset records and additive run provenance; keep continuity epochs and historical unknowns intact.
target_observations.risk: Continuity/qualification epoch collision and production/experimental store scope confusion.

target_observations.authority_boundary: CLI production/experimental, manual controller, and soak cycle establish structured run metadata; RunProvenance carries app version, config fingerprint, git revision, and UUID run identity.
target_observations.evidence_boundary: Run/observation/discovery tables, health, soak state, host migrations, and continuity evidence.
target_observations.material_identity: Git revision, config fingerprint, schema version, and run UUID are the closest existing material identity.
target_observations.reset_boundary: No qualification epoch/reset lineage; host migration is continuity evidence, not a qualification reset.
target_observations.gate_boundary: Production allowlist and soak health summary; no fail-closed qualification epoch gate.
target_observations.persistence_model: SQLite schema version 2 with embedded schema evolution and continuity/soak metadata.
target_observations.migration_need: Additive qualification epoch/reset records linked to existing run UUID/provenance; preserve host migration history.
target_observations.risk: Lowest implementation risk, but existing provenance must not be mistaken for qualification closure and material-change detection is absent.

target_observations.authority_boundary: Bounded soak/campaign and production/manual collection are serialized by the OS advisory lock; campaign manifests bind roster and environment.
target_observations.evidence_boundary: SQLite collector runs, source state, observations, change_events.run_id, and append-only campaign JSONL/manifests.
target_observations.material_identity: Product identity/observations plus roster hash/interpreter environment; no code/config/release identity is tied to qualification.
target_observations.reset_boundary: Campaign closure and historical host records are evidence, not a qualification reset.
target_observations.gate_boundary: Readiness/integrity, allowlist, healthy-cycle count, and human promotion; no epoch-aware fail-closed gate.
target_observations.persistence_model: Inline SQLite schema v1 plus additive v2 change_events.run_id migration and JSONL campaign reports.
target_observations.migration_need: Additive qualification/epoch/reset records linked to run_id; preserve the v2 migration and separate reset from terminal facts.
target_observations.risk: Campaign and production evidence can be conflated unless scope, epoch, and terminal records are explicit.

implementation_families.shared_shape: Qualification projection keyed to an existing run/job identity with explicit trigger provenance, material identity, epoch/reset lineage, and gate projection.
implementation_families.target_local_boundaries: Smartwatch has run-level provenance/UUID; Semiconductor has scheduler/job provenance and a separate editorial promotion model that must remain separate.

implementation_families.shared_shape: Additive qualification rows linked to collector/run IDs; reset and terminal facts are separate; production/experimental or campaign scope is explicit.
implementation_families.target_local_boundaries: Feature Phone keeps data-loss continuity epochs separate; Tablet preserves campaign manifests and change_events.run_id.

implementation_families.shared_shape: Additive invocation/per-source provenance and qualification projection over existing run/health history.
implementation_families.target_local_boundaries: Aggregate invocation and per-source evidence linkage, plus narrative production policy, need explicit mechanics.

implementation_families.shared_shape: If applicable, add the smallest execution/qualification envelope around the external trigger and existing crawler_runs.
implementation_families.target_local_boundaries: There is no in-process scheduler, qualification gate, or release identity today; do not implement a new lifecycle as if it already existed.

batching_order.action: Prototype the rich provenance adapter against existing UUID/config/git records.
batching_order.reason: Richest existing run provenance and material identity; lowest implementation risk.
batching_order.exit_gate: Focused structural proof of epoch/reset/gate semantics without claiming qualification closure.

batching_order.action: Adapt the contract at the scheduler/job boundary.
batching_order.reason: Validates rich ORM family under multiple trigger types while keeping editorial promotion separate.
batching_order.exit_gate: Job-linked qualification evidence and adversarial provenance tests are target-local.

batching_order.action: Apply one per-source SQLite recipe with independent integrations.
batching_order.reason: Shared storage shape and operational scopes; both already have lock remediation evidence.
batching_order.exit_gate: Separate qualification reset/terminal facts; continuity/campaign records preserved.

batching_order.action: Adapt to aggregate invocation and per-source health history.
batching_order.reason: Requires explicit linkage where current aggregate runs and source evidence diverge.
batching_order.exit_gate: Authority and per-source evidence linkage is structurally persisted.

batching_order.action: Run an applicability checkpoint through existing governance before implementation.
batching_order.reason: No existing qualification/promotion lifecycle; a new lifecycle may be governance, not remediation.
batching_order.exit_gate: Explicit applicable/not-applicable decision, not an inferred gate.

batching_order.action: Re-audit source state, then perform per-target read-only live proof.
batching_order.reason: Deployment identity evidence cannot be inherited from Watch or another Clank.
batching_order.exit_gate: Each target has independent source and live identity evidence.

m1_scope_note: Chinese Tech Wire and Smartphone are not included because M1/M2 did not count a qualifying promotion/soak lifecycle for STD-OPS-COM-003; this plan does not reclassify that applicability.

guardrails.decision: Use shared contracts and adversarial proof gates to reduce duplicated reasoning, while keeping implementation and evidence per target. Do not start remediation from this planning artifact alone.
